svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.54k stars in total, about 1.91k a year earlier. jactionlint 351, mr boxington 784, aube 2075, fnox 2415, hk 1350, pitchfork 719, usage 1079, +6 more 767.

g.text: $ gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers --paginate # every tool except mise
cumulative stars since Jan 2025, stacked by launch
